metadata.title: Accessible Forms
metadata.description: W3C WAI form tutorial topics: labeling, grouping, instructions, validation, notifications, and custom controls.

youTubeLink.ariaLabel: Watch the accessible forms YouTube tutorial, opens in new tab

rules.label: Use <label> with htmlFor — never placeholder-only
Use useId() — never hardcode IDs
rules.bad: id='email' breaks when component renders twice

rules.label: Wrap radio & checkbox groups in <fieldset>/<legend>
rules.good: Group name announced with every option
rules.bad: Floating inputs with no group context
rules.code:
<fieldset>
  <legend>Output format</legend>
  <label><input type="radio" name="fmt" /> Text</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="fmt" /> CSV</label>
</fieldset>

// Also for checkboxes
<fieldset>
  <legend>I want to receive</legend>
  <label><input type="checkbox" /> Newsletter</label>
</fieldset>

rules.label: Group related text fields with role="group"
rules.good: Shipping vs Billing clearly distinct to SR
rules.bad: Two 'Name' fields with no distinguishing context
rules.code: Shipping Address

rules.label: Use <optgroup> in <select> for grouped options
rules.good: Group labels read aloud by screen readers
rules.code:
<select>
  <optgroup label="Physics I">
    <option>Lecture 01: Powers of Ten</option>
  </optgroup>
  <optgroup label="Physics II">
    <option>Lecture 01: Electric Field</option>
  </optgroup>
</select>

rules.label: Place overall instructions BEFORE the <form>
rules.good: Screen readers in Forms Mode still read it
rules.bad: Instructions inside <form> — skipped in Forms Mode
rules.code:
{/* Outside
: screen readers read this in browse mode */}
  • Fields marked * are required.
  • Email format: you@example.com
…

rules.label: Link hints with aria-describedby
rules.good: Hint is read after label when field is focused
rules.bad: Hint text visible but ignored by assistive tech
rules.code: We'll never share it.

rules.label: Show error summary & move focus to it on submit
rules.good: SR user immediately hears all errors
rules.bad: Errors shown by fields but focus stays on button

rules.label: Scroll to & focus the first invalid field
rules.good: Sighted keyboard users land on the problem immediately
rules.bad: Page stays at submit button while errors are above

rules.label: Set aria-invalid and link error via aria-describedby
rules.good: Field announces 'invalid' + error text on focus
rules.bad: Red border — invisible to screen readers
rules.code: ⚠ Enter a valid email.

rules.label: Announce outcomes with live regions
rules.good: Screen readers catch async state changes
rules.code:
// Polite: waits for current speech to finish
Form submitted successfully!
// Assertive: interrupts immediately (use sparingly)
Session expired. Please log in again.

rules.label: Custom controls need role + aria state + keyboard
rules.good: Behaves like a native control for all users
rules.bad: div onClick — no keyboard, no SR announcement

rules.label: Never rely on color alone for errors
rules.bad: Red border is the only error indicator

checklist.item: Every input has a <label> linked via htmlFor/id
IDs generated with useId() — no hardcoded duplicates
Related text fields grouped with role="group" + aria-labelledby
Overall instructions placed BEFORE the <form> element
Hints linked to inputs via aria-describedby
Required fields: aria-required + visual asterisk + sr-only text
Failed submit: error summary rendered with role="alert"
Failed submit: focus programmatically moved to error summary
Failed submit: first invalid field scrolled into view
Error summary links point to each invalid field
Each invalid field has aria-invalid + aria-describedby linking its error
Success state announced via role="status" + aria-live="polite"
Custom controls have role, aria-checked/selected, and keyboard handlers
Errors shown with icon + text + color — never color alone
Focus indicators are visible (never outline: none)
Placeholder text is supplementary only, never the sole label

demos.heading: Labeling Controls
demos.description: A visible label linked with htmlFor gives every input an accessible name. Placeholders are never a substitute.

demos.heading: Grouping Controls
demos.description: Radios, checkboxes, and related fields need semantic grouping so screen readers announce the group name alongside each control.

demos.heading: Custom Controls
demos.description: When native elements won't do, add role, aria-checked, and keyboard handlers so custom widgets behave like their native counterparts.

demos.heading: Full Form — All Together
demos.description: Pre-form instructions, fieldset grouping, inline hints, aria-invalid, a focusable error summary, and a live-region success message. Submit empty to see validation in action.
